meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档渲染成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,约 10 分钟后台生成,PDF 存到源文件旁;配好环境变量时还会上传,给出手机分享链接。
howto.when: 当你提到 “wowerpoint this”、“make a deck about <文件>” 等说法,或要求把某份报告转成幻灯片时触发。只做幻灯片,视频和播客不在范围内。

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片
say.note: 先确认源文档,再去生成 PDF
生成约 10 分钟,在后台跑

say.text: 换个提示语,重新生成一版幻灯片
say.note: 复用已有笔记本和源,更快

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Generation runs in the background (~10 min); the PDF is saved next to the source. With WOWerpoint env vars set, it uploads the deck and returns a mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", or a request to turn a report into slides. Slide-decks only; videos and podcasts are out of scope.

say_en.note: Confirms the source document, then generates the PDF
Takes about 10 minutes, runs in the background

say_en.text: Regenerate the deck with a different prompt
say_en.note: Reuses the existing notebook and source
